description: Short logic, sequence and code-reading problems with one right answer.

tasks.title: Ordering
tasks.prompt: Ann is taller than Bo. Bo is taller than Cy. Dee is shorter than Cy. Who is the shortest?

tasks.title: Invalid inference
tasks.prompt: All widgets are gadgets. Some gadgets are blue. Can we conclude that some widgets are blue? Answer yes or no, then explain in one sentence.
tasks.rubric: Correct answer: no. The blue gadgets may not include any widgets.

tasks.title: Overlapping meetings
tasks.prompt: Meeting P runs 09:00-10:00, meeting Q runs 09:45-10:30, meeting R runs 10:30-11:00. Which two meetings overlap?
tasks.rubric: P and Q overlap. R starts exactly when Q ends, so no overlap with R.

tasks.title: Day of week
tasks.prompt: Today is Wednesday. What day of the week will it be 10 days from now?
tasks.rubric: 10 days is one week plus 3 days: Saturday.

tasks.title: Next in sequence
tasks.rubric: Each term is multiplied by 3, so 162.

tasks.title: Read the code
tasks.prompt:
What does this Python program print?

total = 0
for i in range(1, 5):
    total += i * i
print(total)

tasks.title: Spot the failure
tasks.rubric: It raises ZeroDivisionError because the list is empty so len is 0.

tasks.title: Bat and ball
tasks.prompt: A bat and a ball cost $1.10 together. The bat costs $1.00 more than the ball. How much does the ball cost, in dollars?
tasks.rubric: The ball costs 5 cents. A common wrong answer is 10 cents.
